pages.label: Master Dashboard

defects.text: The extended contract date is never stated. Evidence: tiles show "Contract Sep 08, 2027", "Submitted Oct 06, 2027" and separately "13 d approved EOT". 08 Sep 2027 + 13 days = 21 Sep 2027, which is exactly the date behind the -88 h float on VLC-PC-001. The real position (15 days late on the extended date) appears nowhere.

Expired guarantee counted as active security. Evidence: "ACTIVE BONDS 42M". The bond register gives APG-VLC1-0202 (21M) an expiry of 25 Jul 2026, 37 days before the data date. CMeng's own Contract page counts it as expired. The CAR insurance (210M, expired 01 Aug 2026) is not shown at all.

Notice timing shown as nothing. Evidence: "Timely notices 0", "Late notices 0" against 16 dated notices and 16 dated events. The data behind the page marks every event "event_date_missing" although the event start date sits in the same record.

The page contradicts itself on RFIs and NCRs. Evidence: top tiles "53 open, 44 overdue RFIs", "29 major / critical NCR" and an NCR table; lower tiles say "DESIGN SOURCE ROWS 1 document(s) ... a structured row population is not available from the current extraction" and "QUALITY SOURCE ROWS 2 document(s)" with the same sentence.

Procurement register ignored. Evidence: "13 procurement source / scope items ... BOQ-derived package candidates" and "No procurement, BOQ or schedule/WBS long-lead scope is identified". The register holds 90 packages, 30 marked long lead. PKG-0056 (fire pumps, required 29 Aug 2026, still "Ordered") feeds VLC-10-428 on the -88 h chain; PKG-0004 (cables, forecast 21 days after need) feeds VLC-10-548 on the same chain.

Driving chain told wrong. Evidence: "20 driving activities ... Latest finish May 12, 2027 ... a downstream milestone link is not established". The chain is 34 activities, plaster Plot B42 to B70, then MEP, painting and snagging Plot B70, then VLC-10-702 and VLC-PC-001 on 06 Oct 2027. The same page lists both milestones as "CRITICAL, -88 h" a few rows below.

Overrun measured against the original sum only. Evidence: "8.4M QAR forecast overrun" with "BAC 210M". 25 approved variations add 11.78M (current contract 221.78M). The page does not say whether the EAC includes them, so the sign of the answer is unknown.

Delay damages blocked on a false conflict. Evidence (collapsed section): "Delay damages rate · records disagree ... Compare the conflicting records" and "LD amount remains withheld". The contract is sectional: Section 1 QAR 35,000/day, Section 2 (whole of works) QAR 60,000/day, cap QAR 21,000,000. Two sections are not a conflict. At the Section 2 rate the exposure is 1.68M against 08 Sep 2027 and 0.90M against 21 Sep 2027.

Certified unpaid withheld. Evidence (collapsed section): "QAR · Certified unpaid: Unresolved: amount not established in the supplied records". The IPC register has IPC-022 (5,220,369) and IPC-023 (4,678,644) certified with paid amount 0: 9,899,013. Same block says "Pending variations: Unresolved" while the only non-approved VO (VO-026) is rejected, so pending is 0.

Opening the collapsed sections shows raw system references to the user: 59 data paths such as "data.focus.currencies[*].certifiedUnpaidAmount" and "data.focus.liquidatedDamages.scenarios[*].uncappedExposure", 448 references like "evidence-document:evidence_8d5d4743f751bf977010f5a1:row:3" and 35 "population:..." IDs. Expanded, the page grows from 20,000 to 134,000 characters.
"Cross-module consistency: Pass ... 88 checks" while the page itself shows the contradictions in defects 2, 4 and 6.
NCR owners shown as missing. Evidence: "Owner: Not assigned" on every NCR row. The NCR file has a "responsible" party on every open NCR (for example NCR-0042: MEP Coordinator).

Management priorities read as data dumps. Evidence: "1 activities moved 7 elapsed days later ... VLC-10-447 ... ; VLC-10-457" (says 1, lists 2) and "Next: Resolve the identified linked blocker" without naming it. The blockers are NCR-0259 (VLC-10-447) and RFI-0660 (VLC-10-457, overdue since 24 Aug 2026).
Meaningless precision. Evidence: "Difference -0.25 elapsed days. Recalculation minus submitted finish; includes time of day".

Delay counts do not agree. Evidence: "555 delayed activities" in Villa Type B alone vs "Showing 50 of 189 activities" in the attention table. The file has 192 unfinished activities finishing after baseline; the 555 includes finished work.
"Control Readiness 29 CONTROL VIEWS" while the menu has 57 pages.
Raw file name as the programme label: "P8 Update02 2026 08 31".
Footer "A newly uploaded schedule needs your review" still shows after the baseline was adopted.

rules: Show contract date, contract date as extended by awarded EOT, forecast, and days late against both in one row.
Read security status from the expiry date against the data date; file insurance policies as insurance, not bonds.
Count notices as timely or late from the dated event; only report "unknown" when a date is really absent.
One project-facts layer: RFI, NCR, procurement and bond counts come from one place and every page reads it.
Describe the driving chain from the CPM path through to the completion milestone; never cut it to the first 20 rows.
Report EAC against the original sum and the current contract value, and say which one the cost report uses.
Put delay damages (rate, days, cap) and certified unpaid on the dashboard.
The consistency check must compare the same fact across pages and fail when they differ.

34 separate actions "Activity has -88 hours total float", one per activity, instead of one action for the chain.

rules: Rank actions by effect: float of the linked activity, link to the driving chain or a key milestone, money at stake, then age.

Take the owner from the register's responsible / owner / discipline column before saying "Not assigned".
Issue = the record's own description; action = the next step.
Group same-cause items (one chain, one package, one discipline) into one action with a count.
Pull procurement, permit, security, payment and claim items into the same list, not only RFI and NCR.

rules: Build accountability from the owner fields the registers already carry (responsible, owner, discipline, vendor).
Show one row per party with counts, then the items underneath.
Use the same action population and the same count as the Command Center.
Priority comes from the record's own severity and its effect on critical work, not one fixed level for all.

"Difference -0.25 elapsed days" between the calendar recalculation and the submitted date (time of day only).

One determination total, used everywhere.
Translate exposure codes to words.

CMeng's Completion Forecast page says "1 activity(ies) contain retained source constraints that this CPM calculation does not apply". That constraint is what makes VLC-PC-001 -88 h (11 working days past 21 Sep 2027, contract + 13 d EOT).

CMeng's own CPM is reported "not established" for all 2,057 activities because of that single constraint. Evidence: 500 rows "INDEPENDENT CPM NOT ESTABLISHED"; Completion Forecast "Source constraints REVIEW NEEDED 1". A normal contract-date constraint switches off the independent check for the whole programme.
"Negative float: Unresolved" here; "Negative float 41" on Master Dashboard and Management Brief, same data.

Finished work treated as missing data. Evidence: "Classification unknown 1,837 · 89.3%" and "Float-field coverage: 10.7%". A planner reads this as "the file is broken"; in fact every open activity has float.
Finish variance mixes finished and open work. Evidence: "Late 1,049". Only 192 unfinished activities finish after baseline; the rest finished late in the past. The two numbers mean different things.

Baseline start dates are copies of current start dates on all 2,060 rows (511 rows have baseline start after baseline finish). The page does not flag it, and any "missed start" test built on it is empty.
Large "Comparison with the submitted position" block where every metric is "Submitted value missing" or "Not derivable".

Read constraints from the XER and show each with type, date and the float it creates.
Apply source constraints in CMeng's own CPM (as P6 does) and report the difference, instead of refusing the whole calculation.
Exclude completed activities from float coverage and classification counts; say "220 open activities, all with float".
Check that baseline start and finish come from the baseline file and that start is before finish.

Float shift "Unresolved" for finished activities in the change table.

Long caveat paragraphs ("Current programme dates can include actuals, so agreement with the current plan is not independent evidence of performance ...") under each tile.

"Forecast taxonomy" with six positions, three of them "Not established"; reads as a governance model, not a forecast.

rules: Apply source constraints in the CPM the way P6 does, and also run without them; report both.
Required date = contract date + awarded EOT, always.
Publish the CMeng-checked forecast when the network checks pass; show any remaining caveat as a label, not a block.
Run the risk range whenever the network is valid.

Run the check on whatever scope has data (start with the driving chain) and label assumptions.
Every "missing" item names the exact step to supply it.

Detect crew-sequenced chains (same activity type, consecutive locations linked FS) and test parallel crews and extra working days.
Read late packages from forecast vs required dates and status vs required date.
Produce scenarios with stated assumptions; let the user approve, not the system refuse.

Advance payment outstanding not shown: 21,000,000 advance, 19,603,452 recovered to IPC-023, 1,396,548 outstanding.

rules: Name each certificate figure by its basis: gross work, gross incl. VOs, deductions, net certified, paid, certified unpaid.

Security status from expiry date vs data date; insurance separate from bonds.

Compare AC only with gross measures on the same basis.
